decisions_requested.title: Fleet lifecycle enrichment and additive result-set supersession
Carry nine A4 versioned attributes as AH-34 through AH-42
A second weekly knowledge block in 2027 (26 new snapshot calendar dates)
preserves: SC-05 for all ten v1 calendar rows

frozen_result_set_impact.why_it_does_not_move: Parameterized by aircraft_id 1001. Enrichment adds no event to any anchored aircraft; the nine new AH columns are constant across all 24 anchored events and appear in no frozen output schema.
Aircraft 1004 and event 104001 are untouched.
Depends on AH 102004/102005 and the deliberate absence of configuration 999999 and of a null configuration. New configurations 300000..300012 do not fill either gap.
AM-08 for 1002 is unchanged at 2024-07-01.
Negative typed parameter; every v2 aircraft identity stays inside 1000..1999.
Parameterized by 1001. The 437 new spells are all on filler aircraft.
1004 never enters Storage and gains no event.

This is the only frozen result set whose value depends on the whole aircraft population. Protection is structural: every filler AM-07 and every filler AH-05 is at or after 2025-01-01, so no filler aircraft can be In Service at any month end at or before 2024-12-31. The v1 fixture already relied on the same property; v2 keeps the floor and asserts it directly rather than as a side effect of a 48-day filler window.
frozen_result_set_impact.failure_mode_if_violated: Row count drifts above 132 and new aircraft_type_id values appear in the 2015-2024 window. Caught by the generator pre-publication assertion, the SQL oracle and the RAI query independently.

frozen_result_set_impact.why_it_does_not_move: Parameterized by 1001. Configurations 2001/2002/2003 are byte-identical and the new fleet configurations are referenced only by filler events.

anchored_rows_that_must_survive: Q05-R001 through Q05-R035, all 35, unchanged, with adjacent-pair counts 7/5/9/14 and the 13/13 presence closure
frozen_result_set_impact.why_it_does_not_move: All schedule enrichment lives at 2027 snapshot dates. No row is added at any of the five eligible August 2026 dates, and no 2027 key is present at any 2026 date, so no comparison inside the frozen window changes. The 12,000-key August filler block is byte-identical.
frozen_result_set_impact.failure_mode_if_violated: Extra Q05 rows appear at August comparison dates and the per-pair counts 7/5/9/14 break.

The 24 new market zero-crossings all occur between 2027 snapshot dates. No 2027 carrier or route market is present at any 2026 date.
The October gap-control sequence is untouched and every new snapshot date is after 2026-10-26, so the previous eligible complete date for 2026-10-26 remains 2026-10-05.

frozen_result_set_impact.why_it_does_not_move: Aircraft 1099 receives no new leg and AF-8999 remains absent. The ten new anomaly aircraft are filler on 2027 dates.

Aircraft 1999 exists in AIRCRAFT_MASTER but must have no actual leg with AF-06 = 2026-08-31. v2 moves all filler AF dates from 2040 to 2027, which satisfies this, and assertion 12.1.6 forbids any non-anchored AF row with a 2026 AF-06.
Oracle is scoped to schedule_key SYN-SK-CLOCK_BOUNDARY_001, which is untouched.
Oracle is scoped to PH-01 in (7301..7306, 7309, 7310), PF-01 6201 and schedule_key SYN-SK-UTC-UNRESOLVED at 2026-10-19. All untouched.
Assertion prose over named fixtures; not oracled, and every named fixture is untouched.
Oracle is scoped to SYN-SK-PHY_BASE_700 at 2026-08-31 and the four named SYN-SK-DIAG-* keys. The three new CAP cabin defects use 2027-only keys and are outside the oracle's IN list.

Oracle joins the four literal raw codes against AIRPORT_REFERENCE, which is byte-identical at 45 rows. The airline-domain assertion requires that no new AL alias equals SYN-DUP or SYN-ZZZ and that every golden raw carrier keeps candidate count one.
Curated case labels over the October gap-control sequence and SYN-SK-REAPPEAR_400. Every new snapshot date is after 2026-10-26, so the previous-eligible-complete chain into 2026-10-26 is unchanged.
Scoped to the two named canonical keys. The 500 new union overlaps use 2027 operating dates and disjoint carriers, so neither named key gains or loses a lineage.

Eleven named fixture cases keyed by passenger token and actual flight identifier, not an enumeration of all fulfilments. The 700 new exact fulfilments use identifiers in AVAIL[1989:2689] and 2027 operating dates, disjoint from every named case.
Oracle is scoped to actual flight 7200 and passenger token SYN-PAX-DIVERSION-01.

Row one aggregates over AH rows whose end_event_date is 9999-12-31. Specification 7.5 keeps AH-06 null for every filler event, so 102099 remains the only source-sentinel row. Rows two and three are scoped to aircraft 1004 and 1002.
Oracle is scoped to aircraft 1005 and configuration 2005. Every new fleet configuration sets has_multiple_engine_types false.

risks.risk: Q03-CANONICAL is the only frozen result set that depends on the whole aircraft population; the protection is the 2025-01-01 date floor and it breaks silently if an implementer relaxes it for realism
risks.mitigation: assertions 12.1.2 and 12.1.9, checked pre-publication and again by the SQL oracle and the RAI query

risks.risk: 985 Q03 rows and 392 Q05 rows are too many to hand-review row by row
risks.mitigation: section 3.4 aggregate-first review; the class histogram, per-pair distribution and spell-duration buckets are the binding checks

risks.risk: the fulfilment block deliberately makes PH-01 and AF-01 collide, so the AVAIL slice boundaries are part of the contract and reordering the AF blocks silently moves 700 expected fulfilments
the nine new AH columns widen the watched set, which changes version minting; only the constant-payload rule keeps the anchored aircraft neutral
SCHEDULE_SNAPSHOT grows 78% and the enriched Q05 does roughly five times the v1 comparison work on RAI_XS
risks.mitigation: halve the CORE cohort before touching anything semantic

risks.risk: Q02 cannot express a fleet-wide distribution through its frozen non-nullable aircraft_id parameter
risks.mitigation: ship the distribution as probe_fleet_lifecycle.sql plus four named per-aircraft result sets; widening the parameter schema is offered as an explicit reject-or-accept item, not assumed

risks.risk: order-to-delivery compression to a single day for 700 aircraft is visibly synthetic
risks.mitigation: declared artifact; the alternative weakens risk 1, so the talk track states it

risks.risk: AF-01 has 99 spare identifiers; any future increase in actual legs needs a frozen numeric_namespace_assertion widened
risks.mitigation: none available without a scope supersession; recorded so it is not discovered later
the v1 assertion is restated as every configuration referenced by an event resolves; stated so it is not read as a defect
